messages:
maya: Draft PRD posted for Observability Console — retention + trace UX. Main ask: finalize acceptance criteria and island of edge-case behaviors for retention tiering, trace sampling, and UI flows. PRD: https://redwood.gdoc/obs-retention-prd

sam: reading now, will skim acceptance criteria then comment.

maya: TL;DR of goals:
- clear retention tiers (7d, 30d, 90d, custom) + cost warning UX
- trace sampling config with per-service overrides
- retention->export path for long-term archival
- explicit GDPR deletion flow + audit trail

li: Quick Q — does retention apply to both traces and logs/metrics? we should call out datasets separately.

maya: yes — separate per-dataset settings. UI should make that explicit. added to the PRD.

devon: edge cases I care about:
- user downgrades from 90d to 7d — data deletion timing and notifications
- high-cardinality tag combos causing blowup in trace storage
- partial reprocess vs final deletion semantics for exports

alexa: acceptance criteria proposal:
- UI: retention selector with warning modal for destructive changes
- backend: deletion job respects customer tz and provides deletion job id
- telemetry: retention-change event emitted with old/new and user id
- SLO: retention-change ops < 10min for queued jobs

sam: small note: add a nonblocking fallback when KV store misses during deletion (retry with backoff + ops alert)

maya: added to the matrix. also adding a small config sample for teams to copy:
```json
{
  "dataset": "traces",
  "retention_days": 30,
  "export": {
    "enabled": true,
    "destination": "s3://cust-backups/123",
    "grace_period_days": 14
  },
  "sampling_override": {
    "service:payments": 0.5
  }
}
```

li: GDPR edge-case: if a deletion request intersects with an active export, we need to redact from export or cancel export and mark as redaction pending. that's non-trivial.

devon: can we add acceptance criteria for exports: export snapshot timestamped + immutable until redaction finished? and export consumer must be informed when a redaction occurs.

alexa: rollout plan suggestion:
- alpha: internal only, single-corp test
- beta: 10 pilot customers (opt-in), monitor retention-change errors and export failures
- canary: 1% traffic across regions
- GA: feature flag off by default for older tenants

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled on 1912350000 by @infra-eng :rocket:

maya: Decision needed: can we guarantee export immutability while supporting GDPR redaction? If not, we need to document compromise in PRD.

li: short answer: no guarantee unless we implement downstream contract. we should require export destinations to support object mutation or provide certified connectors. add to PRD as 'export connector requirements'.

sam: small UX ask: add an "impact estimate" before user confirms retention shrink — sample query cost + estimated storage delta.

maya: love that. putting sam on impact-estimate mockups. assigning: @sam (impact mockups), @devon (deletion job spec), @li (export connector reqs), @alexa (rollout checklist + metrics). please review PRD comments by EOD Friday :eyes:

devon: noted, will draft deletion job spec tomorrow.

alexa: will add metrics: retention-change rate, deletion failure rate, export fail rate, mean time to completion.

sam: :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all. leaving open for comments. will merge PRD Friday if no blockers. :v:
